proof:
Source. Parent proof step 4: the layer-cake/Fubini argument that replaces Simon's limit procedure in Ch. 3, 4.3 (4)–(5), chapter-03.txt lines 629–643. Here it is stated abstractly. In the parent, X = ℝ^{m+1}, g = ⟨v, ν⟩, S = B̄_{ρ+δ}(y), B = B̄_ρ(y), c = ½, and the sets {ζ ≥ t} are closed balls.

Notation. L_t := {x : t ≤ ζ(x)}, which is measurable because ζ is. I := (0, 1] ⊆ ℝ carries Lebesgue measure λ. μ_S denotes μ restricted to S; it is a finite measure because μ(S) < ∞. μ(·)_ℝ := ENNReal.toReal.

1. Inclusions. For t > 0, L_t ⊆ S, because x ∉ S gives ζ(x) = 0 < t. For t ≤ 1, B ⊆ L_t, because ζ = 1 ≥ t on B. Hence for t ∈ I, μ(B) ≤ μ(L_t) ≤ μ(S) < ∞, so μ(B)_ℝ ≤ μ(L_t)_ℝ.

2. Reduction to μ_S. ζg vanishes outside S, so ∫ ζ g dμ = ∫_S ζ g dμ = ∫ ζ g dμ_S. For t ∈ I, L_t ⊆ S gives ∫ 1_{L_t} g dμ_S = ∫_{L_t ∩ S} g dμ = ∫_{L_t} g dμ.

3. Layer-cake identity. Put H(x, t) := g(x) if t ≤ ζ(x), and H(x, t) := 0 otherwise. Fix x. Since 0 ≤ ζ(x) ≤ 1, {t ∈ I : t ≤ ζ(x)} = (0, ζ(x)], whose Lebesgue measure is ζ(x). Hence ∫_I H(x, t) dλ(t) = ζ(x) g(x).

4. Fubini. H is measurable on X × ℝ: the set {(x, t) : t ≤ ζ(x)} is measurable because (x, t) ↦ t and (x, t) ↦ ζ(x) are measurable, and g is measurable. Also |H| ≤ 1. The product μ_S ⊗ λ⌞I is a finite measure (total mass μ(S)·1), so H is integrable for it. Both factors are finite, hence s-finite, so Fubini's theorem gives ∫_X (∫_I H(x, t) dλ(t)) dμ_S(x) = ∫_I (∫_X H(x, t) dμ_S(x)) dλ(t). It also gives that t ↦ ∫_X H(x, t) dμ_S(x) is λ⌞I-integrable.

5. Rewriting. By steps 2–4, ∫ ζ g dμ = ∫_X ζ g dμ_S = ∫_I (∫_X H(x, t) dμ_S(x)) dt. For t ∈ I, ∫_X H(x, t) dμ_S(x) = ∫ 1_{L_t} g dμ_S = ∫_{L_t} g dμ.

6. Lower bound. For t ∈ I, the hypothesis, step 1 and c ≥ 0 give ∫_{L_t} g dμ ≥ c μ(L_t)_ℝ ≥ c μ(B)_ℝ. Both sides are λ⌞I-integrable: the left by step 4, and the right is a constant on a set of measure 1. Integrating over I gives ∫ ζ g dμ = ∫_I (∫_{L_t} g dμ) dt ≥ ∫_I c μ(B)_ℝ dt = c μ(B)_ℝ λ(I) = c μ(B)_ℝ. ∎

theorem Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_ce_signed_layer_cake : ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (ζ g : X → ℝ) (S B : Set X) (c : ℝ), Measurable ζ → Measurable g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → MeasurableSet S → μ S ≠ ∞ → (∀ x, x ∉ S → ζ x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ B, ζ x = 1) → 0 ≤ c → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → c * (μ {x | t ≤ ζ x}).toReal ≤ ∫ x in {x | t ≤ ζ x}, g x ∂μ) → c * (μ B).toReal ≤ ∫ x, ζ x * g x ∂μ := by
  intro X _ μ ζ g S B c hζ hg hζ01 hg1 hS hSfin hζS hζB hc hlev
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict S) := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hSfin
  set ν : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) with hν
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ν := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 (by simp)
  set H : X → ℝ → ℝ := fun x t => if t ≤ ζ x then g x else 0 with hH
  have hHmeas : Measurable (uncurry H) :=
    Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_snd (hζ.comp measurable_fst))
      (hg.comp measurable_fst) measurable_const
  have hHint : Integrable (uncurry H) ((μ.restrict S).prod ν) := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound hHmeas.aestronglyMeasurable 1 (Eventually.of_forall fun p => ?_)
    simp only [uncurry, hH]
    split_ifs
    · simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hg1 p.1
    · simp
  -- inner integral in t
  have hinner : ∀ x, ∫ t, H x t ∂ν = ζ x * g x := by
    intro x
    have : (fun t => H x t) = (Iic (ζ x)).indicator (fun _ => g x) := by
      funext t; simp [hH, indicator_apply, mem_Iic]
    rw [this, integral_indicator_const _ measurableSet_Iic, smul_eq_mul, hν, Measure.real,
      Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Iic]
    have hset : Iic (ζ x) ∩ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Ioc 0 (ζ x) := by
      ext t; simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Iic, mem_Ioc]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2, _⟩; exact ⟨h2, h1⟩
      · rintro ⟨h2, h1⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2, h1.trans (hζ01 x).2⟩
    rw [hset, Real.volume_Ioc, sub_zero, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hζ01 x).1]
  -- left side
  have hleft : ∫ x, ζ x * g x ∂μ = ∫ x, ∫ t, H x t ∂ν ∂(μ.restrict S) := by
    simp_rw [hinner]
    rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    simp [hζS x hx]
  -- right side for t ∈ (0,1]
  have hright : ∀ t ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫ x, H x t ∂(μ.restrict S) = ∫ x in {x | t ≤ ζ x}, g x ∂μ := by
    intro t ht
    have hLmeas : MeasurableSet {x | t ≤ ζ x} := measurableSet_le measurable_const hζ
    have hLS : {x | t ≤ ζ x} ⊆ S := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxS
      have := hζS x hxS
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
      linarith [ht.1]
    have : (fun x => H x t) = {x | t ≤ ζ x}.indicator g := by
      funext x; simp [hH, indicator_apply]
    rw [this, integral_indicator hLmeas, Measure.restrict_restrict hLmeas, inter_eq_left.2 hLS]
  have hlow : ∀ t ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, c * (μ B).toReal ≤ ∫ x, H x t ∂(μ.restrict S) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hright t ht]
    refine le_trans ?_ (hlev t ht.1 ht.2)
    have hBL : B ⊆ {x | t ≤ ζ x} := fun x hx => by simp [hζB x hx, ht.2]
    have hLS : {x | t ≤ ζ x} ⊆ S := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxS
      have := hζS x hxS
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
      linarith [ht.1]
    have hLfin : μ {x | t ≤ ζ x} ≠ ∞ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hSfin (measure_mono hLS)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ENNReal.toReal_mono hLfin (measure_mono hBL)) hc
  have hint_t : Integrable (fun t => ∫ x, H x t ∂(μ.restrict S)) ν := hHint.integral_prod_right
  have hswap := integral_integral_swap hHint
  calc c * (μ B).toReal = ∫ t, c * (μ B).toReal ∂ν := by
        simp [hν, Measure.real]
    _ ≤ ∫ t, ∫ x, H x t ∂(μ.restrict S) ∂ν := by
        refine integral_mono_ae (integrable_const _) hint_t ?_

        exact Eventually.of_forall hlow
    _ = ∫ x, ∫ t, H x t ∂ν ∂(μ.restrict S) := hswap.symm

Since ζg vanishes off S, pass to the finite measure μ⌞S, on which ∫_{{ζ≥t}} g dμ = ∫ 1_{{ζ≥t}} g dμ⌞S.
Layer cake: ζ(x)g(x) = ∫_{(0,1]} 1{t ≤ ζ(x)} g(x) dt.
Fubini for the bounded measurable integrand on the finite product μ⌞S ⊗ λ⌞(0,1].
